##Joseki
This sequence gives up one stone in the corner. In the past, this kind of joseki didn't exist. After AI got strong, it confirmed that this is the best way for both. (See [AI Masterclass](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MqlC8Zj6JfM&t=291s).)

White intends to attach at <X:R11>, professionals occasionally do it before the push at <A:N15>.
